description_html:
Light Paper Texture Feel Matte Film, Scratch Resistant, Real Pen Touch Sensitivity


Paper Feel for Writing & Drawing: paper feel texture that delivers an exceptional tactile experience for pen touch input.

Scratch-Resistant & Anti-Fingerprint Coating: Durable matte surface resists scratches, dust, and fingerprints—keeping your screen clean and clear.

High Touch Sensitivity: Maintains real touch responsiveness for flawless accuracy while drawing.

Matte Finish: Minimizes reflections and eliminates glare for comfortable viewing in lighting. No more rainbow effects and reduce harsh screen glare.

UV Protection for Eye Comfort: Blocks harmful UV rays to reduce eye strain during extended screen time.

Important Notice: This is a paper texture screen protector designed to enhance your pen drawing and writing experience with a natural, tactile feel. Please be aware that while it provides excellent pen touch responsiveness, the textured surface may cause your pen tip to wear down over time. If you prefer not to replace pen nibs periodically, this product may not be the right fit for you.
